translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for shoulder pain due to stiff shoulders, low back pain, joint pain, muscle pain, tenosynovitis (pain and swelling of the hand, wrist and ankle), elbow pain (such as tennis elbow), bruises and sprains.
translation.usage: Apply the patch to the affected area once or twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine; people who have or have had asthma caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (which can trigger asthma attacks); people who have experienced urticaria or acute rhinitis caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs; women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; children under 15 years of age. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who are under treatment by a doctor; people who have experienced an allergic reaction. Bathing with the patch on causes strong irritation, so remove it at least 30 minutes before bathing or apply it at least 30 minutes after bathing. Do not warm the area where the patch is applied with a heater, an electric blanket or the like. Do not use it for more than 2 consecutive weeks. People with delicate skin must not apply it repeatedly to the same area. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. Use it only when you have symptoms. If you are sweating or the affected area is wet, wipe it dry before use. People with delicate skin should first apply a small piece of about 1 to 2 cm to a delicate area on the inner arm for at least half a day and confirm that no rash, redness, itching or inflammation occurs before use. Do not use this medicine in the following cases: the area around the eyes or mucous membranes. Do not use this medicine in the following cases: eczema; inflamed areas; athlete’s foot; insect-bitten areas; suppurating areas or wounded areas. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if occasional redness, rash, itching, swelling, stinging, inflammation or blisters occur, or if symptoms of shock occur (urticaria, swelling or chest discomfort immediately after use, together with pallor, cold hands and feet, cold sweat and difficulty breathing). Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use the product after its expiry date.
